# FXC comparison for #3883, via ce-probe.py (committed beside this file).
# Compiler Explorer, fxc_10_0_19041. Read-only: these compile, they publish nothing.
# The control (control-initialised.hlsl) is what makes the first result evidence rather
# than an observation: FXC accepts the same shader once the variable is initialised.

### $ python ce-probe.py fxc_10_0_19041 repro.hlsl "/T ps_5_0 /E PSMain"
### compiler: fxc_10_0_19041
### source:   repro.hlsl
### args:     /T ps_5_0 /E PSMain
### exit:     1

[stdout] 
[stderr] <source>(8,10-22): error X4000: variable 'index' used without having been completely initialized
[stderr] 
[stderr] compilation failed; no code produced
